    rcases h with ⟨y, hy⟩

        (y - b)^2 = y^2 - 2*b*y + b^2 := by ring
        _ = (x^2 + 8*x + y^2 - 2*b*y) - x^2 - 8*x + b^2 := by ring
        _ = t - x^2 - 8*x + b^2 := by rw [hy]
        _ = t - (x^2 + 8*x - b^2) := by ring
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ t - (x^2 + 8*x - b^2) := by
      rw [← h_sq_eq]
      exact sq_nonneg _
    linarith
  · intro h
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ t - (x^2 + 8*x - b^2) := by linarith
    set d := t - (x^2 + 8*x - b^2) with hd
    have hd_nonneg : 0 ≤ d := h_nonneg
    use b + Real.sqrt d
    have h_sq_sqrt : (Real.sqrt d)^2 = d := Real.sq_sqrt hd_nonneg

theorem quadratic_y_solvable_parameterized (x b t : ℝ) :
  (∃ y : ℝ, x ^ 2 + 8 * x + y ^ 2 - 2 * b * y = t) ↔
    x ^ 2 + 8 * x - b ^ 2 ≤ t := by
  have h_main_implication : (∃ y : ℝ, x ^ 2 + 8 * x + y ^ 2 - 2 * b * y = t) → x ^ 2 + 8 * x - b ^ 2 ≤ t := by
    intro h
    rcases h with ⟨y, hy⟩
    have h₁ : x ^ 2 + 8 * x + y ^ 2 - 2 * b * y = t := hy
    have h₂ : (y - b) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y - b)]
    have h₃ : x ^ 2 + 8 * x + y ^ 2 - 2 * b * y = x ^ 2 + 8 * x + (y ^ 2 - 2 * b * y) := by ring
    rw [h₃] at h₁
    have h₄ : y ^ 2 - 2 * b * y = (y - b) ^ 2 - b ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h₄] at h₁
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y - b)]
  
  have h_converse_implication : x ^ 2 + 8 * x - b ^ 2 ≤ t → (∃ y : ℝ, x ^ 2 + 8 * x + y ^ 2 - 2 * b * y = t) := by
    intro h
    
    use b + Real.sqrt (t - (x ^ 2 + 8 * x - b ^ 2))
    have h₁ : t - (x ^ 2 + 8 * x - b ^ 2) ≥ 0 := by
      nlinarith
    have h₂ : Real.sqrt (t - (x ^ 2 + 8 * x - b ^ 2)) ≥ 0 := by positivity
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : t - (x ^ 2 + 8 * x - b ^ 2) ≥ 0), sq_nonneg (b - Real.sqrt (t - (x ^ 2 + 8 * x - b ^ 2)))]
  
  have h_final : (∃ y : ℝ, x ^ 2 + 8 * x + y ^ 2 - 2 * b * y = t) ↔ x ^ 2 + 8 * x - b ^ 2 ≤ t := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_main_implication h
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_converse_implication h
  
  exact h_final
